title: pomtree configuration
description: The JSON config file named by $POMTREED_CONFIG. Precedence: default < this file < env < --set. Every key is restart-only. Sensitive keys are not accepted here; supply each through its <ENV>_FILE path env.

maxBytes.description: Cap on one agent report body (POST /v1/agents/self/reports). Unit: bytes. Env: POMTREED_REPORT_MAX_BYTES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed, examples/hn-digest.

workflowMaxBytes.description: Ceiling on one workflow-capability report and fetch. Unit: bytes. Env: POMTREED_REPORT_WORKFLOW_MAX_BYTES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed, examples/hn-digest. Must be <= report.maxBytes.

dir.description: Where agent reports are stored. Unset: <state.dir>/reports. Env: POMTREED_REPORT_DIR. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

maxBytes.description: Cap on one agent push body (POST /v1/agents/:id/push) and on one result-save bundle. Unit: bytes. Env: POMTREED_PUSH_MAX_BYTES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed, @pomtree/sandbox-docker.

rootMicros.description: The root budget pool that top-level agents are carved from. Unit: micro-dollars (1000000 = $1). Env: POMTREED_BUDGET_ROOT_MICROS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

topLevelMicros.description: Budget carved for a top-level (operator) spawn that names none. Unit: micro-dollars (1000000 = $1). Env: POMTREED_BUDGET_TOP_LEVEL_MICROS. Scope: run. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed. Refused above the ceiling budget.rootMicros.

defaultMicros.description: Budget carved for an agent-spawned child that names none. Unit: micro-dollars (1000000 = $1). Env: POMTREED_BUDGET_DEFAULT_MICROS. Scope: run. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed. Must be <= budget.topLevelMicros.

raiseMs.description: Per-rung window of a human rung on a budget_raise approval. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_BUDGET_RAISE_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

raisePct.description: Requested budget raise, as a percent of the agent's original budget. Unit: count. Env: POMTREED_BUDGET_RAISE_PCT. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

maxBytesCeiling.description: Ceiling on the maxBytes a browser_capture call may request (raw body and rendered DOM). Unit: bytes. Env: POMTREED_BROWSER_CAPTURE_MAX_BYTES_CEILING. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/agent-image, examples/hn-digest. Must be <= browser.capture.rawAllocationMaxBytes. Must be <= report.maxBytes.

rawAllocationMaxBytes.description: Largest declared main response a capture buffers at all (Playwright reads the whole entity); beyond it nothing is read. Unit: bytes. Env: POMTREED_BROWSER_CAPTURE_RAW_ALLOCATION_MAX_BYTES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/agent-image. Must be <= capacity.containerMemoryBytes.

textMaxBytes.description: UTF-8 bytes of mechanical page text a capture stores whole as one retained report (the digest's analyst reads it in pages); text beyond it is clipped and marked truncated. Unit: bytes. Env: POMTREED_BROWSER_CAPTURE_TEXT_MAX_BYTES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/agent-image, examples/hn-digest. Must be <= report.maxBytes.

screenshotMaxBytes.description: Largest capture screenshot PNG; a larger one is retaken smaller, never truncated. Unit: bytes. Env: POMTREED_BROWSER_CAPTURE_SCREENSHOT_MAX_BYTES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/agent-image, examples/hn-digest. Must be <= report.maxBytes.

deadlineMinMs.description: Smallest deadline a browser_capture call may request. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_BROWSER_CAPTURE_DEADLINE_MIN_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/agent-image, examples/hn-digest. Must be < browser.capture.deadlineMaxMs.

deadlineMaxMs.description: Largest deadline a browser_capture call may request. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_BROWSER_CAPTURE_DEADLINE_MAX_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/agent-image, examples/hn-digest.

dir.description: The daemon's state directory (store, tokens, socket). Unset: ~/.pomtreed. The pomtree client reads it to find the socket and operator token. Env: POMTREED_STATE_DIR. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed, @pomtree/pomtree, examples/hn-digest.

grants.description: State-store grants: {"<driver or template id>": [{owner, prefix?, mode: "r"|"rw"}]}. Parsed by pomtreed parseStateGrants. Env: POMTREED_STATE_GRANTS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

limits.description: State-store quotas: {default?: Limits, owners?: {name: Limits}}; unset fields inherit STATE_LIMITS_DEFAULT. Parsed by core parseStateLimits. Env: POMTREED_STATE_LIMITS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed, examples/hn-digest.

dir.description: Agent template directory. Unset: <state.dir>/templates. Env: POMTREED_TEMPLATES_DIR. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.
Root of the per-agent Pi session directories. Unset: <state.dir>/sessions. Env: POMTREED_SESSION_DIR. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

maxMs.description: Longest session a spawn may request. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_SESSION_MAX_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed. Must be <= agent.tokenTtlMs.

defaultMs.description: Session length of a spawn that names none. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_SESSION_DEFAULT_MS. Scope: run. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed. Refused above the ceiling session.maxMs.

dir.description: Environment layer cache (<dir>/<manifestHash>). Unset: <state.dir>/env-cache. Env: POMTREED_ENV_CACHE_DIR. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.
Extension host directory (realpathed at start). Unset: <state.dir>/extensions. Env: POMTREED_EXTENSIONS_DIR. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

approval.description: Extensions whose gated actions need an approval: none, all, or a comma list of extension names. Required: pomtreed refuses to start while it is unset. Env: POMTREED_EXTENSIONS_APPROVAL. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

path.description: The daemon's operator unix socket. Unset: <state.dir>/pomtreed.sock (shortened when over the OS path limit). Clients use POMTREE_SOCKET. Env: POMTREED_SOCKET_PATH. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

additionalProperties.description: One sandbox backend's keys, sandbox.<id>.<key>, where <id> is the camelCase of the backend id. Declared by the adapter's or extension's manifest and validated at startup against the composed backends; unknown ids are refused.

socket.description: The daemon socket's path inside an agent container. Env: POMTREED_SANDBOX_SOCKET. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

backend.description: Which sandbox backend runs agents: auto, docker, podman, kubernetes, sail, e2b, or the id an installed extension provides (that one also needs a pin in sandbox.reviewedBackends). auto picks an installed local engine (docker, then podman) and never a hosted or contributed backend. The backend's own keys are sandbox.<id>.*. Env: POMTREED_SANDBOX_BACKEND. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

secretsInEnv.description: Allow a backend with no better channel to receive the daemon token in the sandbox's create-time environment, which the provider console and engine inspect output can show. Off: such a backend is refused for agents that need a token. Env: POMTREED_SANDBOX_SECRETS_IN_ENV. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

reviewedBackends.description: Content-hash pins of reviewed extension-provided backends, entries <id>=sha256:<hex>. A contributed backend is constructed only when sandbox.backend names it and its directory hashes to its pin here; a changed byte refuses boot and prints the new hash. Env: POMTREED_SANDBOX_REVIEWED_BACKENDS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

maxDayMicros.description: Daily runtime spend ceiling across all backends together, in micro-dollars. 0 = a billed backend admits nothing until the operator sets it; local backends that bill nothing ignore it. Unit: micro-dollars (1000000 = $1). Env: POMTREED_SANDBOX_MAX_DAY_MICROS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

listen.description: Agent endpoint listener, host:port ([::1]:0 for IPv6; port 0 = ephemeral) or off. Unset: Linux binds the docker bridge gateway plus loopback, elsewhere 127.0.0.1:0. An explicit host other than loopback or the detected docker bridge gateway needs listen.allowNonloopback. Parsed by pomtreed parseListen. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_LISTEN. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

probe.description: On Linux with the gateway plan, prove agent-endpoint reachability from a real container at start. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_PROBE. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

image.description: The agent container image. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_IMAGE. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

egressProxyImage.description: The digest-pinned image the per-agent egress-proxy sidecar runs for every container spawn (name[:tag]@sha256:<64 hex>, or a local image id sha256:<64 hex>, e.g. the agent image's id from docker image inspect --format '{{.Id}}'), checked with docker image inspect before each sidecar starts. Required: pomtreed refuses to start while it is unset. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_EGRESS_PROXY_IMAGE. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

untemplatedEgress.description: Egress of a spawn that names no template (the built-in code template): registry (the model proxy and the package registries only; use this for a first run) or none (no network at all: an untemplated agent cannot reach the model proxy, so its model calls fail; pomtreed warns at start). Required: pomtreed refuses to start while it is unset. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_UNTEMPLATED_EGRESS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

tokenTtlMs.description: Lifetime of the agent API token issued when a container starts. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_TOKEN_TTL_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

maxDepth.description: Deepest spawn depth allowed. The root supervisor is depth 0 and operator-spawned agents are depth 1; a spawn is refused when its depth exceeds this value, so 0 refuses all spawns and 1 permits only operator-spawned agents. Unit: count. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_MAX_DEPTH. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

maxChildren.description: Unreaped children one non-root parent may hold. Unit: count. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_MAX_CHILDREN. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

zombieMs.description: How long an exited agent may stay unreaped before the zombie sweep raises an alert; the sweep never reaps it. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_ZOMBIE_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

zombieSweepMs.description: Interval of the zombie sweep, which also applies `--ttl` expiry on held children. Lower it only to make tests deterministic. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_ZOMBIE_SWEEP_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

reconcileSweepMs.description: Interval between reconcile passes (container and record drift, operator-token expiry). Lower it only to make tests deterministic. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_RECONCILE_SWEEP_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

rootCustodyMax.description: Exited results held for the operator because their parent chain is dead up to the root; past this many, each further delivery is also raised as an alert. Results are never dropped. Unit: count. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_ROOT_CUSTODY_MAX. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

interruptGraceMs.description: After an interrupt, how long Pi may take to exit before the container is killed. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_INTERRUPT_GRACE_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

adoptOrphans.description: On start, adopt running agent containers this daemon has no record of. Env: POMTREED_AGENT_ADOPT_ORPHANS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

listen.description: Operator UI listener, host:port or off. Loopback only unless listen.allowNonloopback. Parsed by pomtreed parseListen. Env: POMTREED_UI_LISTEN. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

Host-read (adapter) listener, host:port or off. Loopback only unless listen.allowNonloopback. Parsed by pomtreed parseListen. Env: POMTREED_HOST_LISTEN. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

id.description: This daemon's host id, stamped on every record. Unset: os.hostname(). Env: POMTREED_HOST_ID. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

allowNonloopback.description: Accept a non-loopback bind for the plain-HTTP UI and host listeners, and an agent listener on a host other than loopback or the docker bridge gateway (put TLS and auth in front). Env: POMTREED_LISTEN_ALLOW_NONLOOPBACK. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

allowSandboxDown.description: Report ready while the sandbox (Docker) is down. Env: POMTREED_READYZ_ALLOW_SANDBOX_DOWN. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

mode.description: Access log on stdout, one line per request, for the daemon and the model proxy. auto: all on a TTY, else errors. Env: POMTREED_ACCESS_LOG_MODE. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

timeoutMs.description: How long shutdown waits for in-flight work to drain. Keep below the service manager's stop timeout. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_DRAIN_TIMEOUT_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

retentionMs.description: How long idempotency records are kept. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_IDEMPOTENCY_RETENTION_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

spoolVacuumGraceMs.description: How long after its sandbox closed an egress audit spool is kept before it is deleted, once every row is acknowledged and journaled (the journal is the record; the spool is the raw copy). 0 = delete as soon as eligible. Each spool counts against the spool retention cap (AUDIT_MAX_SPOOLS) until then. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_AUDIT_SPOOL_VACUUM_GRACE_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

retentionMs.description: Journal pruning age; 0 = no pruning. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_JOURNAL_RETENTION_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

keepPerAgent.description: Newest journal entries kept per agent when pruning (journal.retentionMs > 0). Unit: count. Env: POMTREED_JOURNAL_KEEP_PER_AGENT. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

retentionMs.description: Paused agents idle past this lose their folder; 0 = never. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_FOLDER_RETENTION_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

reapedGraceMs.description: How long a reaped agent's folder is kept. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_FOLDER_REAPED_GRACE_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

minFreeBytes.description: Below this much free disk the cleanup sweep removes eligible folders early; 0 = off. Unit: bytes. Env: POMTREED_FOLDER_MIN_FREE_BYTES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

dir.description: The operator's repository agents clone from and merge into. Unset: the daemon's working directory. Env: POMTREED_REPO_DIR. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

defaultBranch.description: The branch agents start from and merge into. Unset: the repository's HEAD branch, else main. Env: POMTREED_REPO_DEFAULT_BRANCH. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

deny.description: Repo-relative path prefixes a merge may not touch. Empty = no denylist. Env: POMTREED_MERGE_DENY. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

check.description: Whitespace-separated command a merge must pass; empty = merges run with no check. No check runner is wired in this build, so pomtreed refuses to start while it is set. Env: POMTREED_MERGE_CHECK. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

targets.description: remote/branch targets the daemon may publish to (only the daemon pushes). Env: POMTREED_PUBLISH_TARGETS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

deny.description: Repo-relative path prefixes a publish may not touch. Empty = no denylist. Env: POMTREED_PUBLISH_DENY. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

scan.description: Scan a publish for credentials, commit messages and CI-file additions before pushing. Env: POMTREED_PUBLISH_SCAN. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

steerExt.description: Load the Pi mailbox (steer) extension, through which a waiting agent sees messages. Env: POMTREED_HARNESS_STEER_EXT. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed, @pomtree/harness-pi.

jobsExt.description: Load the opt-in, unverified Pi background-jobs extension. Env: POMTREED_HARNESS_JOBS_EXT. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed, @pomtree/harness-pi.

yieldMs.description: A pomtree wait/inbox/ask wait longer than this yields the agent's container instead of long-polling. pomtreed delivers it to agent containers, so the in-container pomtree long-polls exactly as long as the daemon allows. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_WAIT_YIELD_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed, @pomtree/pomtree.

maxSessions.description: Concurrent session cap: auto (min(memoryFraction*RAM/containerMemoryBytes, cpus/2*3, maxContainers, 16), at least 2) or a positive integer, which bypasses the 16 cap. Env: POMTREED_CAPACITY_MAX_SESSIONS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

maxContainers.description: Container limit enforced by the resource gate; also bounds the auto session cap. Unit: count. Env: POMTREED_CAPACITY_MAX_CONTAINERS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

containerMemoryBytes.description: Memory limit of a container whose spec names none, and the per-running-container reservation the memory gate and the auto session cap plan for. Unit: bytes. Env: POMTREED_CAPACITY_CONTAINER_MEMORY_BYTES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

memoryFraction.description: Fraction of host RAM the memory gate and the auto session cap may plan for. Env: POMTREED_CAPACITY_MEMORY_FRACTION. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

minDiskFreeBytes.description: Free disk below which the resource gate refuses new sessions. Unit: bytes. Env: POMTREED_CAPACITY_MIN_DISK_FREE_BYTES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

sweepMs.description: Watchdog sweep interval. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_WATCHDOG_SWEEP_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

stallMs.description: Silence after which the watchdog judges an agent stalled. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_WATCHDOG_STALL_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

blockedMs.description: Time blocked after which the watchdog acts. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_WATCHDOG_BLOCKED_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

intensityWindowMs.description: Window over which watchdog restart intensity is counted. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_WATCHDOG_INTENSITY_WINDOW_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

stableMs.description: Run time after which a restarted agent counts as stable again. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_WATCHDOG_STABLE_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

tickMs.description: Cron scheduler tick interval. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_CRON_TICK_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

sweepMs.description: Folder cleanup sweep interval. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_CLEANUP_SWEEP_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

timeoutMs.description: Per-rung fail-closed window of a human approval rung (also the web_fetch approval window). Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_APPROVAL_TIMEOUT_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.
How long an ask stays open. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_ASK_TIMEOUT_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

agentRungMs.description: Per-hop window of an agent rung on a bubbled ask or approval. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_ESCALATION_AGENT_RUNG_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

channels.description: Ordered channels asks and alerts go out on; the root broadcasts to every one. Env: POMTREED_ESCALATION_CHANNELS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.
Chat-rank messaging channels to enable (each needs the sender allowlist POMTREED_MESSAGING_SENDERS). Env: POMTREED_MESSAGING_CHANNELS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

allowSpawn.description: Allow chat-rank senders to spawn agents. Env: POMTREED_MESSAGING_ALLOW_SPAWN. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

approval.description: Chat-initiated routes (spawn, cancel) that wait for a human approval. Env: POMTREED_CHAT_APPROVAL. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

reviewedExtensions.description: Extensions whose workflow drivers are reviewed. Validated by pomtreed WorkflowRuntimePolicy. Env: POMTREED_WORKFLOW_REVIEWED_EXTENSIONS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

templates.description: Templates each reviewed workflow driver may spawn: {"<ext>/<driver>": ["<template>", ...]}. Parsed by pomtreed WorkflowRuntimePolicy. Env: POMTREED_WORKFLOW_TEMPLATES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

userAgent.description: The one operator identity for every fetch path: sent on every request and redirect hop of agent web_fetch, the workflow fetch capability and every capture broker rung, and appended to Chromium's own User-Agent in browser captures (never a desktop-browser impersonation). Free-form, but it must start with a product token (an app name, optionally /version). A contact (an email address or an http(s) URL) is optional but recommended, e.g. "pomtree (+https://example.org/contact)"; some sites, such as SEC EDGAR, ask for one. Its product token is also the robots.txt token evaluated beside Claude-User. Blank or unset: the default "pomtree". pomtreed logs the effective identity at startup. Env: POMTREED_WORKFLOW_FETCH_USER_AGENT. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

minIntervalMs.description: Minimum time between two requests the workflow fetch capability sends to the same host, across every workflow on this daemon; each redirect hop is a request. E.g. 100 keeps SEC EDGAR (sec.gov) under its 10 requests per second. 0: unpaced. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_WORKFLOW_FETCH_MIN_INTERVAL_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

mode.description: Test mode: the only switch that admits the test-only seams below. pomtreed prints a WARNING at start while it is on. Never set it in production. Env: POMTREED_TEST_MODE. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

fetchHosts.description: Test only, refused unless test.mode: route the workflow fetch capability for these hosts to a loopback fixture, {"data.sec.gov": 8443} -> http://127.0.0.1:8443 with the original Host header. The capability's allowlist, budget and caps still apply; other hosts use the network. Empty: off. Env: POMTREED_TEST_FETCH_HOSTS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

baseUrl.description: The model provider's upstream base URL. Required: pomtreed refuses to start without it. Env: POMTREED_MODEL_BASE_URL. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

upstreamTimeoutMs.description: Upstream request timeout of the model proxy; also the stale-reservation reclaim age. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_MODEL_UPSTREAM_TIMEOUT_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

port.description: Model proxy TCP port. Unit: count. Env: POMTREED_MODEL_PROXY_PORT. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

ttlMs.description: Lifetime of the scoped model-proxy key issued when a container starts. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_MODEL_PROXY_TTL_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

maxRequestMicros.description: Reserved (and charged when cost cannot be read) per request to a model missing from the catalog. Not a per-request ceiling. Unit: micro-dollars (1000000 = $1). Env: POMTREED_MODEL_PROXY_MAX_REQUEST_MICROS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed, examples/hn-digest.

extraPaths.description: Upstream paths the proxy allows beyond its default allowlist. Env: POMTREED_MODEL_PROXY_EXTRA_PATHS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

provider.description: The provider the scoped proxy credential is written for (required; e.g. openrouter). Env: POMTREED_PI_PROVIDER. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

catalogDir.description: Pi model catalog directory (pricing). Unset: found from the pi binary on PATH. Env: POMTREED_PI_CATALOG_DIR. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

provider.description: web_search provider; empty = none. Env: POMTREED_SEARCH_PROVIDER. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

enabled.description: Offer web_fetch (runs on the host network, bypassing container egress). Env: POMTREED_WEBFETCH_ENABLED. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

maxCalls.description: web_fetch and web_search calls allowed per agent per fixed window (one shared count). Windows are aligned to the Unix epoch, not sliding, so up to twice this many calls can pass in a short span across a window boundary. Unit: count. Env: POMTREED_WEBFETCH_MAX_CALLS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

windowMs.description: Length of the web_fetch and web_search call-quota window. Fixed windows start at multiples of this since Unix time 0 (not sliding), so a burst can span a boundary (see webfetch.maxCalls). Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_WEBFETCH_WINDOW_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

timeoutMs.description: Whole-call deadline of one agent web_fetch call, every redirect hop included; past it the call is aborted and fails as a timeout. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_WEBFETCH_TIMEOUT_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

maxTotalBytes.description: Total web_fetch bytes allowed per agent. Unit: bytes. Env: POMTREED_WEBFETCH_MAX_TOTAL_BYTES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

waitMs.description: How long a capture request blocks before it returns pending (the requireApproval precedent); retrying with the same idempotency key, or waiting on the job, converges on the same job. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_CAPTURE_WAIT_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

timeoutMs.description: Whole-acquisition deadline of one capture rung (connect, first byte and body, every redirect hop included); past it the rung fails as a timeout. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_CAPTURE_TIMEOUT_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

maxBytes.description: Per-capture body cap; a larger body fails too_large. At most 16 MiB, the egress proxy's per-connection relay cap. Unit: bytes. Env: POMTREED_CAPTURE_MAX_BYTES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

stableMs.description: Maximum age of a cached capture of a stable page (DOI landing pages, documentation, reference pages). Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_CAPTURE_FRESHNESS_STABLE_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

dailyMs.description: Maximum age of a cached capture of a daily page (articles, filing indexes, blog posts); the default class. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_CAPTURE_FRESHNESS_DAILY_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed. Must be <= capture.freshness.stableMs.

liveMs.description: Maximum age of a cached capture of a live page (feeds, front pages, prices). Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_CAPTURE_FRESHNESS_LIVE_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed. Must be <= capture.freshness.dailyMs.

rules.description: Operator freshness rules, first match wins: [{"host": "www.sec.gov", "pathPrefix": "/Archives/", "class": "immutable"}, ...]; class is immutable, stable, daily or live. A URL no acquirer classes and no rule matches is daily. Parsed by core parseFreshnessRules. Env: POMTREED_CAPTURE_FRESHNESS_RULES. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

denylist.description: Hosts the broker never captures (blocked/policy): each entry matches the host and its subdomains (core denylistMatch). Env: POMTREED_CAPTURE_DENYLIST. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

requests.description: Capture requests one agent may make per capture.quota.windowMs (cache hits included: the quota bounds the requester, not the origin). Unit: count. Env: POMTREED_CAPTURE_QUOTA_REQUESTS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

windowMs.description: The capture request quota window. Unit: milliseconds. Env: POMTREED_CAPTURE_QUOTA_WINDOW_MS. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

endpoint.description: OTLP exporter endpoint; empty = no export. Env: POMTREED_OTLP_ENDPOINT. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtreed.

debug.description: Rethrow unexpected CLI failures with their stack instead of one line. Env: POMTREE_CLIENT_DEBUG. Scope: operator. Restart-only. Consumers: @pomtree/pomtree.

ext.description: Extension-contributed keys, ext.<segment>.<key>, where <segment> is the camelCase of the extension's name. Declared by each extension's manifest and validated at startup against the loaded extensions; unknown or unloaded keys are refused.
